components.name: Primary action

components.name: Hex field

components.name: Sample row
components.description: Static thumbnail and compact metadata with a selected surface.
components.css: .ds-sample{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4286;color:#131416;display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:34px;border:1px solid #cdced1;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 11px;background:white;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;border:0;background:#e5edef;width:100%;padding:9px 8px;text-align:left;justify-content:flex-start;gap:10px;border-radius:8px;white-space:normal}.ds-sample:hover{background:#e9eff0}.ds-sample:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1b6c80);outline-offset:3px}.ds-thumb{width:48px;height:48px;flex:none;background:#f9fbfb;border-radius:8px}.ds-sample span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}.ds-sample strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:500}.ds-sample small{font-size:11px;line-height:16px;color:var(--muted,#5d5f60);margin-top:3px}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-sample{min-height:68px}.ds-sample strong{font-size:14px}.ds-sample small{font-size:12px}}

components.name: Panel tabs
components.description: Text tabs with a quiet underline; behavior is supplied by the app.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#e8eaec)}.ds-tabs button{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4286;color:#131416;display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:34px;border:1px solid #cdced1;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 11px;background:white;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;padding:0 0 12px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;min-height:32px;color:var(--muted,#5d5f60);position:relative}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:var(--raised,#f4f6f8)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1b6c80);outline-offset:3px}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:#131416;font-weight:500}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]:after{content:"";position:absolute;height:2px;background:#131416;bottom:0;left:0;right:0}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-tabs{gap:25px}.ds-tabs button{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;padding-bottom:13px}}

components.name: Framed working sheet
components.description: Main white workspace container; not a generic card system.
components.css: .ds-sheet{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4286;color:#131416;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 288px;gap:24px;background:white;margin:0 8px 8px 0;border-radius:16px;padding:24px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}.ds-sheet aside{border-left:1px solid var(--border,#e8eaec);padding-left:24px}@media(max-width:1099px){.ds-sheet{margin-left:8px;padding:20px;gap:20px}.ds-sheet aside{padding-left:20px}}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-sheet{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin:0 8px 8px;padding:18px 16px;gap:27px;overflow:visible}.ds-sheet aside{border-left:0;padding-left:0}}

components.name: Original to replacement mapping
components.description: Signature color row with separate original and editable target.
components.html: 2
components.css: .ds-row{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4286;color:#131416;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:16px}.ds-swatch{height:30px;width:30px;min-height:30px;flex:none;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #00000012;border:0;padding:0;background:#1b6c80}.ds-target{border:2px solid white;outline:1px solid #cdced1;cursor:pointer}.ds-target:hover{background:revert}.ds-target:focus-visible,.ds-rowhex:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1b6c80);outline-offset:3px}.ds-row>svg{flex:none;color:#7c8387}.ds-rowhex{font-family:"IBM Plex Mono",monospace;width:94px;min-width:0;border:1px solid #cdced1;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:6px 7px;font-size:12px;line-height:18px;color:#131416}.ds-count{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#5d5f60);margin-left:auto}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-row{gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}.ds-swatch{width:38px;height:38px;min-height:38px}.ds-target{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px}.ds-rowhex{font-size:16px;width:115px;min-height:44px}.ds-count{font-size:12px}}

narrative.overview:
A quiet, slightly teal frame holds a white working sheet. Animation and the user's palette provide the visual energy; chrome stays restrained, readable and direct. The recurring loop mark and original-to-replacement color rows give the tool its identity.

This is a scan of the implemented Moro workbench and Read documentation surface, based on `apps/web/src/main.tsx` and `apps/web/src/style.css`. It replaces the earlier Lottie Studio v0.2 design system under the user's approved identity replacement. The approved authority is `brief/PRODUCT-UI-SPEC.ko.md`, its layout SVGs and `brief/design-tokens.json`; the latter still labels itself proposed, so the tokens above capture actual source values rather than silently treating the proposal as implementation. This was code-led from the exact brief; no raster comp or QUALITY BAR card was selected.
keyCharacteristics: A pale L-shaped frame around one white working sheet.
A large preview with precise, compact color mappings beside it.
Self-hosted IBM Plex typography and restrained teal focus cues.
Responsive composition that puts mobile controls in normal page flow.

rules.name: The Artwork Color Rule
rules.body: Keep chrome neutral and teal; allow the loaded animation and user-selected palette to be multicolored.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Reserve overlay lift for dialogs; use tone and a divider for the working regions.

dos: **Do** keep one quiet frame and white working sheet around the animation.
**Do** preserve visible original-to-target color mappings and preview-only background labeling.
**Do** use Plex Sans for UI, Plex Mono for hex/code, and Korean system fallbacks.
**Do** retain the mobile minimum button target (44×44px) and normal page flow.
**Do** distinguish observed source values from proposed brief values and unverified device behavior.
donts: **Don't** add decorative gradients, glass, glow, dot grids or routine panel entrance motion; the transparency checkerboard is functional.
**Don't** turn the workbench into a promotional landing page or a grid of nested dashboard cards.
**Don't** restore the superseded layer editor, timeline/keyframe lane or SVG editing controls.
**Don't** imply cloud saving, accounts, remote AI generation or a public GitHub destination.
**Don't** claim universal 16px mobile typography, complete Korean translation or verified physical-device keyboard behavior.
